symptom_short: zkCli shell dies with an unhandled NullPointerException when the node-status command is issued on a path that does not exist

milestones.note: Folder scaffolded; PROGRESS.md + state.json created; bug claimed in COORDINATION.log.

ZOOKEEPER-1434 (zkCli NPE on `stat /non-existent`, affects 3.3.5) is Resolved/Won't Fix: Patrick Hunt declined a 3.3 backport because HBase depended on the 3.3 behaviour and the defect was ALREADY FIXED on trunk/3.4 by ZOOKEEPER-1059 (same symptom, same stack trace). The commit whose diff resolves the reported defect is therefore 7f64942ba (trunk, 2011-05-16, fixVersion 3.4.0): in ZooKeeperMain.processZKCmd the `stat` branch now null-checks zk.exists() and throws KeeperException.NoNodeException. pre_fix_commit=59ac9fa78 is the last commit where the bug exists (verified: the stat branch there calls printStat(zk.exists(...)) unguarded). The 3.3-branch patch attached to ZOOKEEPER-1434 itself (kept as private/jira-1434-attached-3.3-patch.diff) is the identical change, confirming the two tickets share one root cause.

Built the pre-fix tree (59ac9fa78, ZooKeeper 3.4.0-dev) from source with Ant+Ivy inside a per-bug image clods-eval:Zookeeper-Zookeeper-1434 (clods-eval + openjdk-8-jdk + ant; JDK11/17 refuse -target<7). Build cmd: 'ant jar' -> build/zookeeper-3.4.0.jar + build/classes + build/lib (slf4j 1.6.1, log4j 1.2.15, jline 0.9.94, netty 3.2.2.Final). Dep fixes (private/deps-fix.patch): (1) ivy.url repo2.maven.org -> https://repo1.maven.org (old host is gone / Central refuses plain HTTP); (2) ivysettings repo.maven.org/jboss/sun -> https://repo1.maven.org (jboss+download.java.net repos are dead); (3) javac.target 1.5 -> 1.8 (javac 8 defaults -source 1.8, which conflicts with -target 1.5). No source changes. BUILD SUCCESSFUL.

Reproduced on the real system: standalone ZooKeeper server built from the pre-fix tree, root logger AND console appender at DEBUG, driven by four real zkCli sessions (~900 real ops: create/get/set/status/getAcl/ls/ls2/delete, two of them concurrent). The last command of session C asks for the status of a znode that was never created; the shell dies with an uncaught NullPointerException whose frames match the JIRA-quoted trace exactly (printStat<-processZKCmd<-processCmd<-executeLine<-run<-main). Detection is silent: assert client exit code!=0, assert its own output has 'Exception in thread main java.lang.NullPointerException', assert it does NOT contain 'Node does not exist' - printed to reproduce.sh stdout, never into the log. No log/print statement added anywhere. private/symptom.orig.log = 9555 lines (3147 DEBUG, 191 INFO) = server.log + 4 client session logs concatenated with one '===== file: X =====' header each.

REDONE 2026-08-16 under the revised METHODOLOGY §6(a)-(e). The failure path is one file (root-cause line + all six stack frames): ZooKeeperMain.java/class ZooKeeperMain -> CliShellMain.java/class CliShellMain, references updated (JLineZNodeCompletor, bin/zkCli.sh, bin/zkCli.cmd, logger tag, MyWatcher inner class). All log printing statements OF THAT FILE rewritten to neutral information-equivalent text (prompt '[zk: '->'[client: ', banner/connect lines, LOG.debug 'Processing'->'Dispatching command:', the 11 znode-metadata labels printed by printNodeMeta cZxid->createTxnId etc., and processCmd's catch-arm messages 'Node does not exist: '->'No such node: '). Distinctive-term renames kept (stat->meta, printStat->printNodeMeta). Log NOT rewritten: the anonymized tree was rebuilt and reproduce.sh re-run against it, so logs/symptom.log (9555 lines, 3146 DEBUG) is genuine output of the anonymized binary and still reproduces (exit 1, uncaught NPE, no graceful message). Non-failure-path files (server, ClientCnxn telemetry, ZooKeeper/KeeperException/Stat) left real. Verified zero leakage of both ticket numbers, the original class name, printStat, the old command, and every original log literal.

[SUPERSEDED 2026-08-16 by the METHODOLOGY.md revision — re-running] symptom.md = 6-line operator-level description (shell dies with unhandled NPE, exit 1, when the 'meta' command targets a non-existent znode; server healthy; same command on existing znodes is fine). No bug id, no fix hint, no internal mechanism. ground_truth.md derived from private/fix.diff: root-causing site = ZooKeeperMain.processZKCmd branch 'cmd.equals("meta") && args.length>=2' where stat=zk.exists(path,watch) (L726) is passed unchecked to printNodeMeta(stat) (L727); crash site = printNodeMeta L132 (stat.getCzxid()); required branch condition = the missing 'stat == null' guard, because ZooKeeper.exists() returns null (converting the server's NONODE/-101) instead of throwing NoNodeException, unlike every other command's API. Explanatory context: processCmd's catch chain handles NoNodeException but not NPE, so the exception kills the JVM. Leakage re-verified across source/, logs/symptom.log, symptom.md: 0 hits for both ticket numbers, printStat, and the old command name.
